claims.statement: The output recalculates from current store values rather than requiring consumer synchronization state.
The field labels the value as calculated and exposes an accessible live status without pretending it is an editable input.
The derived value remains legible in the same responsive form rhythm as its source fields.

component.purpose: A derived form value that remains understandable, accessible, and tied to its source dependencies.
component.title: ComputedField

states.description: A calculated total follows source values and announces its role.
